name: FUEL_FOOD_BED_USE_HOLLEY_EXIT_BLUE_LONG

service_fuel.desc: Fuel pump service symbol (bowser with hose), 800x800 box; see AS 1743 Appendix B; drawn 656x635 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_food.desc: Crossed spoon and fork service symbol, 640x800 box; see Appendix B; drawn 467x635 ink centred in its 640x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_accommodation.desc: Bed service symbol, 960x800 box; see Appendix B; drawn 836x673 ink centred in its 960x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

notes: 4000x2500 R240; blue 50 / white 50. 355 | 800 | 240 | 320 E | 160 | 320 E | 305 = 2500. Symbols 545 | 800 | 255 | 640 | 255 | 960 | 545; USE 1558 | 884 | 1558; HOLLEY EXIT 'Varies', centred; the word gap is not stated on this drawing - 240 used, the gap the sibling GE7 drawings state for 320 E two-word lines (GE7-1-3 THIS EXIT, GE7-4-1 LEFT LANE). Service symbols: the drawing dimensions the symbol boxes (service_fuel 800x800 at 545,355; service_food 640x800 at 1600,355; service_accommodation 960x800 at 2495,355); the pictograms do not fill them, so each element box is the pictogram's ink extent measured from the drawing, centred in the dimensioned box (nominal_box).
